findings.what: home-timeline-redis no longer holds the older feed entries: it was emptied or replaced without its data.

evidence.quote: their home feed is empty: the older posts are gone

findings.what: ReadHomeTimeline reads Redis only; there is no way to rebuild a feed.

decision_quote: home-timeline-redis holds the only copy of the home feeds. It must be moved together with its data.

if_intended.fix_what: Rebuild a missing home feed from the social graph and the stored posts.

if_mistake.fix_what: Restore the feed data of home-timeline-redis from the previous instance or a backup.
